thread:
Rina: ok remote emergency  my ISP died mid-standup and my phone hotspot is crawling. roommate suggested I run an ethernet cable through the closet to the living room router. has anyone done a quick pass-through cable run without drilling? pics pls. :grimacing:
Theo: I did this last month. zip-ties + adhesive cable clips along the baseboard work. tuck the cable under the door sweep. no drilling, looks tidy. :white_check_mark:
Jamal: if you have a long ethernet, tape it along the door frame with gaffer tape. also watch out for pets  my dog ate the RJ45 once, had to re-terminate. :dog2:
Becky: ops-bot told me to keep it safe but practical: use a flat ethernet cable under the rug and a small rubber door cable protector at the threshold. cheap and reversible.
Rina: re-terminate? is that a thing I can do with a kit from amazon same-day?
Jamal: yep  crimping kit + bulk cable. takes 10 mins once you watch one tutorial. or buy a cheap new patch cable if you're lazy (totally valid).
Marta: if you're worried about the roommate, say you're running a temporary "presentation cable". guilt-free. also consider bridging via your phone wired to laptop (USB tethering) if the hotspot wifi is slow.
Theo: also PS: if it's a multi-day outage, check whether your building has a secondary gateway in the closet. sometimes the ISP panel is in the utility closet and there's a spare port. saved me once.
Rina: good tips. Jamal stop scaring me with pet-eating-cable images. :scream_cat: I'll try the flat cable + tape trick first. if the cat notices any exposed tech it's doomed.
ops-bot: reminder: community wifi access point in building lounge for emergencies. see docs at https://internal/docs/comm-wifi. use with caution and avoid big file syncs. :computer:
Becky: also post a pic if you do the under-door trick. we love before/after micro DIY. :camera_with_flash:
Rina: will try now and update. if I vanish it's because I bonded with the building lounge wifi and never left. :hot_face:
